title: Esther Chosen as Queen

questions.question: Who proposed gathering virgins for the king?
options: The king’s young men who attended him
questions.correctAnswer: The king’s young men who attended him
questions.explanation: Esther 2:2 (ESV): "Then the king's young men who attended him said, 'Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.'"

questions.question: Who was the custodian of the women?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:3 (ESV): "...into the custody of Hegai the king's eunuch, who is in charge of the women..."

questions.question: What was Esther’s Hebrew name?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:7 (ESV): "He was bringing up Hadassah, that is Esther..."

questions.question: How long did the beauty treatment last?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:12 (ESV): "...for so were the days of their beautification completed: six months with oil of myrrh and six months with spices and ointments..."

questions.question: What favor did Esther win from Hegai?
options: She pleased him and won his favor, receiving cosmetics and portions effectively
questions.correctAnswer: She pleased him and won his favor, receiving cosmetics and portions effectively
questions.explanation: Esther 2:9 (ESV): "And the young woman pleased him and won his favor. And he quickly provided her with her cosmetics and her portion of food..."

questions.question: What did Mordecai forbid Esther to reveal?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:10 (ESV): "Esther had not made known her people or kindred, for Mordecai had commanded her not to make it known."

questions.question: In what year of his reign did the king make Esther queen?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:16 (ESV): "...in the tenth month, which is the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign."

questions.question: Who sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:21 (ESV): "...Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king's eunuchs... sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus."

questions.question: Who told Esther about the plot?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:22 (ESV): "And this came to the knowledge of Mordecai, and he told it to Queen Esther..."

questions.question: Who was Mordecai’s great-grandfather mentioned in the genealogy?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:5 (ESV): "...Mordecai the son of Jair, son of Shimei, son of Kish..."

questions.question: Who had carried Kish into exile?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:6 (ESV): "...whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away."

questions.question: How many maids were assigned to Esther from the king’s palace?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:9 (ESV): "...and with her seven chosen maids from the king's palace..."

questions.question: Who was in charge of the concubines (the second harem)?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:14 (ESV): "...into the custody of Shaashgaz the king's eunuch who was in charge of the concubines."

questions.question: What did Esther take with her when she went to the king?
questions.explanation: Esther 2:15 (ESV): "...she asked for nothing except what Hegai... advised."

key_verse_text: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she won grace and favor in his sight more than all the virgins, so that he set the royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.
